blocks.text: Jade LeMac, the Vancouver-based singer-songwriter and multi-instrumentalist whose music has reached a growing global audience, is entering a new chapter with “Prettier With Your Mask Off,” her new single arriving November 6th via Warner Music Canada / East West Records. The song is the first release from Jade’s forthcoming EP, due in early 2027. Jade has quickly established herself as an artist to watch, building an audience through her distinctive songwriting and emotionally driven music.
